title: Ukrainian-Style Baked Potato Pilaf
description: A hearty and flavorful baked potato pilaf, inspired by Ukrainian cuisine. This dish is perfect for a weeknight dinner or a special occasion.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the cubed potatoes, caraway seeds (if using), chopped onion, and minced garlic.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the chicken broth and lightly baked pilaf mix.
Pour the wet ingredients over the potato mixture and stir until everything is well combined.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and cover with aluminum foil.
Bake for 30 minutes, then remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 20-25 minutes, or until the potatoes are tender and the top is lightly browned.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs (such as parsley or dill) if desired.
